meeting_point.mellin_identity: Integral_0^infinity (theta_E8(it)-1)t^(s-1)dt = pi^(-s) Gamma(s) * 240 zeta(s)zeta(s-3), initially in its convergence domain and then meromorphically continued.
meeting_point.dilation: After x=log t, Mellin restriction to a vertical line is Fourier transform in x. On L2(R_+,dt/t), -i d/d(log t) is self-adjoint with continuous spectrum R.
meeting_point.zero_status: Zeros of zeta(s)zeta(s-3) are zeros (not eigenvalues) of a matrix coefficient/Mellin transform of the generalized vector theta-1; poles/resonances arise only after continuation. A spectral measure is positive and lives on the real generator spectrum, whereas the meromorphic transform may vanish off that spectrum.
meeting_point.hecke_precision: The repository establishes Kneser/modular Hecke correspondences on E8 lattice/theta channels and E4 as a simultaneous Eisenstein eigenform. It does not establish that all T_p are characterwise diagonal operators on the fixed torus L2 space.
meeting_point.connes_quotient: A Connes-type realization replaces the compact torus by the noncompact adele-class quotient A_K/K* with its multiplicative scaling action. For K=Q(i), K* includes Gaussian primes and the unit group mu4; TFPT's mu4 mark matches that unit group but does not construct the quotient or action.

r129.result: Any bounded Theta with Theta+Theta*=I has W=Theta Theta*=1/4+S*S >=1/4. Hence its normalized moments cannot reproduce the certified falling source diagonals: the interior self-dual requirement is unconditionally unsatisfiable at safe anchors. Matched off-line blocks can be exactly self-dual, while on-line zeros cannot; thus this interior self-duality selects violations rather than RH.
r129.scope: This is not a no-go for self-dual Haar measure or all adelic constructions. Finite-window Krein/CMV completions are exactly self-dual; the RH-priced step is the L-to-infinity/all-window quantifier.

Their arithmetic L-functions occur as heat traces or spectral zeta functions; zeros created by meromorphic continuation are not operator eigenvalues. A zeros-as-spectrum realization needs a noncompact scaling system of Connes/Berry-Keating type plus an explicit-formula trace and a canonical self-adjoint realization. The origin layer supplies none of these jointly.

circularity: Postulating positivity, self-adjointness, or a positive inner product specifically for an arithmetic generator already identified through the Weil explicit formula assumes the decisive content. The generator, domain, metric, and trace identification must be derived independently.
verdict: The origin story contains many genuine positivity structures, but none currently supplies bridge 2. The E8 theta heat trace is the sole natural meeting point carrying both Gaussian/Gamma/pi and Hecke/census data; it fails by discrete-spectrum neutrality. Operator seeds (OS, modular K, QCA, H_Lambda) lack prime data, while arithmetic E8/Hecke structures lack an independently derived noncompact self-adjoint scale generator. No structure passes both the blindness filter and the explicit-formula identification test, so no frozen contract is justified.
